changelog.title: Premium interface, reliable updates and Java runtime selection
changes: Native app upgrade required once for older APKs: use the APK on this release; existing servers are retained when installed over the old app.
Verified complete web bundles load HTML, JavaScript and CSS after activation; failed downloads keep the installed app.
Future native upgrades download inside the app and open Android installation confirmation; package, version and signing certificate are checked.
Android Java 21/25 use pinned Bionic ARM64 archives with checksums; MC 26.x selects Java 25.
System Bionic allocator verification, Android 16 JVM compatibility flags, actual device RAM/CPU limits, and Phone Storage permission flow.

changelog.title: Control Buttons, Plugin Manager & Backup Management Suite v1.0.7
changes: Fixed JavaScript initialization crash restoring all Settings buttons (reinstall, delete server, Java selector, sliders)
Fixed Modrinth API timeout compatibility for Android WebView so Plugin Manager browse and search work smoothly
Added full Backup Management Suite with live backup file listing, creation date, size, and type indicators
Added 1-tap Restore and Delete controls for backups, plus directory path inspection (/storage/emulated/0/JtgCraft/server/backups)
Automatic bytecode patching for Playit plugin forcing IPv4 to resolve UnsupportedAddressTypeException

changelog.title: Java 21 Manual Override & Compact Console Banner v1.0.6
changes: Enabled manual Java version override in Settings allowing MC 1.20.1 to run on Java 21 for modern plugin support
Added automatic background downloading and runtime installation of Java 21 ARM64 when configured
Streamlined console IP/network card into an ultra-compact slim strip maximizing vertical terminal log view
Added fallback to installed Java 17 runtime in case of network interruption during startup

changelog.title: Server Properties Search, Safe Shutdown & OTA Engine v1.0.5
changes: Added instant real-time search filter in Server Properties (online-mode, pvp, difficulty, port)
Added safe server world flush (save-all) and clean app exit on in-app update apply
Added dynamic GitHub OTA hot-patch loader running updates without APK reinstall
Eliminated Paper watchdog tick hang/crash and tuned JVM G1GC flags for stable Wi-Fi LAN join
Display server-allocated RAM limit (2048 MB) instead of physical mobile RAM in top header bar
Filtered cosmetic Android ARM64 OSHI Microarchitecture diagnostic warning from mobile console

changelog.title: Java Runtime Installation & Scoped Storage Fix v1.0.4
changes: Fixed EACCES (Permission denied) on Java runtime setup by directing download and extraction to isolated app internal storage (getFilesDir)
Secured persistent archive caching in app-specific external storage (getExternalFilesDir) avoiding Android 11+ Scoped Storage restrictions
Eliminated unverified fallback to /storage/emulated/0/Download paths during Java environment setup
Added test-read validation before attempting to unpack any cached Java runtime archives
Synchronized installed OTA version state to prevent repeated update banners after patch application

changelog.title: File Manager, Plugin Manager & Settings Engine Fix v1.0.3
changes: Fixed File Manager folder navigation and file editing by providing required isDir and rel path attributes
Fixed Plugin Manager Upload .jar button with native mobile file chooser dialog
Added missing Server Settings backend methods: Change Version, Reinstall Server, and Delete Server
Fixed Java runtime version display in Settings (eliminated undefined version text)
Formatted file, plugin, and world sizes properly in MB across all management screens

changelog.title: Mobile Server Execution & UI Stability Hotfix v1.0.2
changes: Fixed server start/stop button toggling by correctly parsing native state payload
Fixed restart process polling loop hanging indefinitely
Added Netty NIO transport (-Dio.netty.transport.noNative=true) to prevent Android socket native crash
Added Paper JVM bypass flags (-DPaper.IgnoreJavaVersion=true) for mobile stability
Added automatic web asset synchronization before compiling Android APK
Enforced Os.chmod 0755 execution permissions for Java runtime and JNI libraries

changelog.title: Mobile Core Engine & UI Polish v1.0.1
changes: Persistent OpenJDK runtime caching across app reinstalls (auto-detects local archive to avoid re-downloading)
Custom server install directory support with quick presets (App Storage, Downloads, Phone Storage) and folder browsing
Console server startup fix with Android-specific JVM flags, writable Netty JNI tmpdir, and watchdog disable
File Manager PC-style glassmorphic UI overhaul with always-visible touch actions (Rename, Delete, Extract)
Direct mobile file uploading for plugins, worlds, and configs using Base64 encoding
Safe server shutdown on app swipe/destroy to prevent world corruption
Continuous background execution via persistent Android Foreground Service with CPU WakeLock

changelog.title: Initial Mobile Release (Android APK) v1.0.0
changes: Full Minecraft Java server management directly on Android phones (Android 6.0+)
Automated Adoptium Linux aarch64 ARM64 portable JRE manager & runtime
Background execution with persistent Foreground Service & CPU WakeLock to prevent server sleep
Responsive glassmorphism mobile UI with bottom navigation bar & touch gestures
Interactive Minecraft server console with virtual keyboard optimization
File Manager with batch operations, safe-guarding .mcmeta.json metadata
Full Modrinth plugin catalog browser & installer for mobile
World importer/exporter with ZIP compression support
Independent mobile update engine (separate from PC desktop releases)
